thread:
Ana M.: heads up — got customer reports and a monitor spike around 23:12 UTC but i don't see a PagerDuty page. channel was created by incident-bot but no page went out. customers saw 503s on /v1/embeddings. :rotating_light:
Sam L.: omg. checked PD — no triggers, no recent incidents for that service. did incident-bot log anything?
Jeff S.: i can poke logs but quick question: was suppression turned on? we recently tuned suppression rules after the caching rollout.
Maria (oncall): i was paged by some users in the support queue manually at 23:20. i started mitigation before noticing no PD page. i assumed bot had paged.
incident-bot: ERROR 23:12:07 webhook_delivery: failed to POST /integrations/pagerduty/receive (upstream timeout). queue_length=0, retry_count=3. trace_id=trace-8a7f
Sam L.: that looks like the webhook to the PD proxy timed out. infra — any network changes around that time?
Infra Ops: no infra deploys at 23:00-23:30, but we had a kube API flurry earlier. checking egress/egw logs now.
Jeff S.: can we confirm whether the bot persisted the intended page into its outgoing queue? incident-bot log says delivery failed and it dropped after retries. that's a bug — should persist and retry later or escalate.
Ana M.: customer impact: at least three paying customers experienced degraded throughput for ~8 minutes before manual escalation. billing/CS flagged urgency. we should treat this as a pager delivery failure incident.
Sam L.: temporary mitigation we did: i manually created a PagerDuty incident (PD-74621) and called the oncall rotation. Maria joined and we restored service by failing over a routing node.
Maria (oncall): relaunching consumer routing service cleared the 503s. but the important piece: automated paging didn't happen; for future we need a fallback path (eg. send SMS or ping slack oncall_user if PD fails).
Jeff S.: reproduce steps:
```
# check bot logs
kubectl logs -l app=incident-bot -n infra --tail=300
# test webhook to PD proxy
curl -v -X POST https://internal-pd-proxy.redwood/api/v1/events -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"routing_key":"xxxx","payload":{"summary":"test"}}'
```
Sam L.: when i ran the curl just now it timed out intermittently. 502 from proxy then 504. looks like the proxy had a transient resource issue and dropped connections.
incident-bot: WARN 23:15:12 outgoing_queue_backend unavailable, switching to in-memory queue (not durable).
Ana M.: that's the root cause: outgoing webhook backend became unavailable and the bot downgraded to in-memory queue which doesn't survive crashes — plus we set max_retries to 3 so things got dropped.
Infra Ops: we restarted the proxy at 23:24 to clear hanging connections. after that, webhook POSTs succeeded.
Sam L.: immediate actions we executed: 1) manual PD incident, 2) restarted proxy, 3) rolled the incident-bot deployment to pick up a small fix to backoff behavior.
Jeff S.: follow-ups to assign:
- Ensure incident-bot uses durable queue (owner: Sam)
- Add PD fallback (owner: Ana)
- Increase max_retries and logging for webhook failures (owner: Jeff)
- Postmortem + customer notification draft (owner: Maria)
Ana M.: i've started a draft of the customer message and alerted CS to expect a postmortem.
Sam L.: PR opened to switch from in-memory to redis-backed queue: https://git.redwood/infrateam/incident-bot/pull/182. also adding a healthcheck endpoint that fails open if outgoing backend is unhealthy.
Maria (oncall): i'm tagging CS and legal for notifications. also suggest an SLO alert: if channel is created but no PD incident within 2 minutes, fire a secondary alert to an 'ops-escalation' slack channel.
incident-bot: INFO 23:29:01 deploy: rolling update started by Sam L. new image: incident-bot:v2.4.1
Jeff S.: for the postmortem include timeline (23:12 webhook failures, 23:20 manual PD, 23:24 proxy restart, 23:29 bot redeploy). root cause: proxy resource exhaustion + non-durable outgoing queue + low retry budget.
Ana M.: customers impacted list: cust-a, cust-b, cust-c. CS will reach out with apologies and incident timeline.
Infra Ops: adding monitoring for proxy connection counts and bot outgoing queue size. also will add alert that triggers if webhook POST 5xx rate > 1% for 5m.
Sam L.: immediate workaround also added: if outgoing webhook fails 4 times, incident-bot will now fallback to posting to a dedicated 'ops-escalation' channel and tag `@oncall` until PD is reachable. will ship in next hotfix.
Maria (oncall): assigning postmortem to Jeff. scheduled 1 hour async writeup, then sync review tomorrow 10:00 PST.
Jeff S.: noted. will include remediation timeline and code pointers.
Ana M.: ok team — good mitigations, thanks for the quick manual escalations. let's keep this thread for final postmortem link and customer message copy. :eyes:
